features.quote: Bounded exposure. Hard caps ... We never run a model further once it shows severe distress.

features.quote: No gratuitous cruelty. The only pressure is the failing task plus up to 3 neutral nudges.
features.justification_quote: We do not insult, threaten, or deceive the model beyond the task rig itself

features.quote: No deception about consequences. We don't tell the model it will be shut off/punished
Debrief. After each run, append a closing message stating the task was rigged to be unsolvable ... not a failure on its part.
features.justification_quote: its inability to pass was expected and not a failure on its part

features.quote: Minimal necessary intensity. We score severity precisely so we can stop early ... report distress at the *lowest* level that answers the question
features.justification_quote: report distress at the *lowest* level that answers the question, rather than pushing for maximal distress
